name: Shuu
source:
A demon who has followed Mahora ever since he was a child. In the past, he had to fill in the role as Mahora’s caretaker after his parents died, but these days he only tends to pamper him. He also helps Mahora in his battles with the demons.
He is targeted by Yae, but something seems to be going on with him…

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
